stops.title: Outpatient Pharmacy
stops.summary: Where the prescription becomes a safe, understandable medicine handover.
stops.patientValue: Patients receive the correct medicine with an opportunity to ask questions before leaving.
stops.ask: What should I check before I leave with my medicines?

stops.title: Counselling Room
stops.summary: A quieter space for questions that deserve time and privacy.
stops.patientValue: Patients and caregivers can discuss use, side effects, storage, and concerns without feeling rushed.
stops.ask: Can we go through how I should use this medicine?

stops.title: Value Added Services
stops.summary: Alternative pathways that can make collecting medicines easier for eligible patients.
stops.patientValue: The service reduces barriers while keeping the prescription and handover process safe.
stops.ask: Which collection option is suitable for me?

stops.title: PRIC
stops.summary: Pharmacy support that follows the patient across the care journey.
stops.patientValue: Medication information is connected rather than left in separate pieces.
stops.ask: Who can help me understand all my medicines together?

stops.title: IPD & Discharge
stops.summary: Pharmacy work that protects the move from hospital to home.
stops.patientValue: Patients leave with clearer instructions and a safer plan for continuing medicines.
stops.ask: What changed in my medicines before I go home?

stops.title: Clinical Pharmacy
stops.summary: Medication expertise brought into complex patient care.
stops.patientValue: The wider healthcare team can make better-informed medication decisions.
stops.ask: Can the pharmacist review my medicines with the team?

stops.title: Logistics & Store
stops.summary: The quiet system that helps keep patient medicines available and reliable.
stops.patientValue: Care is less likely to be interrupted because essential medicines are planned, stored, and monitored.
stops.ask: How does Pharmacy prevent medicine supply gaps?

stops.title: Manufacturing & Repacking
stops.summary: Specialist work that supports safe preparation, packaging, and traceability.
stops.patientValue: Medicines are handled with documented processes and quality attention.
stops.ask: How is medicine quality protected during preparation?
